meta.title: Repo review — line-by-line spot verification
meta.method: Each claim below was compared against the official page named in its source column, fetched with fetch_page. Values that were not re-fetched are listed as Not checked, not as confirmed. Pass 1 (C-01–C-10) ran on 26 Nov 2026; pass 2 (C-11–C-17) re-read seven restaurant pages and menus on 27 Nov 2026.
limits: Hotel booking-engine prices were NOT re-priced in this session. They remain Booking.com search snapshots captured 2026-11-25.
YouTube, TikTok and Instagram links were NOT opened in this session.
Hotel official_url links were NOT re-fetched in this session (only the Michelin, MGM, Wynn, Cosmopolitan and RTC pages above were).
Transit minutes are estimates. No official door-to-door time exists, so they cannot be verified.
Restaurant menu prices were re-read for the seven venues in C-11 to C-17 only; the other 17 restaurant pages were not re-opened on 27 Nov 2026.

checks.item: 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest — Las Vegas star and Bib tiers
checks.compared: Official press release names Joël Robuchon (2 stars), é by José Andrés, Guy Savoy and L'Atelier (1 star each), and China Poblano, Esther's Kitchen and YEN Viet Kitchen as Las Vegas Bib Gourmands. The visitlasvegas page lists 17 Recommended Las Vegas restaurants.
checks.detail: Matches data/restaurants.json: 1 two-star, 3 one-star, 3 Bib Gourmand, 17 Recommended (24 total).

checks.compared: Official press release page is dated 31 Aug 2026 (its PDF filename carries 20260828). The site's data says the selection was announced 26 Aug 2026.
checks.detail: The 26 Aug date in data/restaurants.json (meta.important_note) does not appear on the official page, so it cannot be confirmed. Left unchanged and flagged as R-05.

checks.detail: The data field was blank. Filled from this official page in this session (one of the data changes made under T12, logged in COORDINATION.md).

Remain snapshots from 2026-11-25. Recheck on the official booking engine for the exact dates before any decision.
Links remain as recorded by earlier sessions.

checks.detail: $6 / $8 / $20. The 'fare change proposed from 2027-01-31' noted by an earlier session was not on this page, so it remains unverified (not confirmed either way).

checks.item: Restaurant Guy Savoy — à-la-carte prices and the 'Krug Chef's Table' figure

checks.detail: The page lists individual dishes at $110, $120, $100, $160, $200, $290 and a $60 cheese cart — per person. The stored cell showed '$200–$580 à la carte' under a 'Cost for 2 adults' heading, and a '$3,000 Krug Chef's Table' that the page does not print at all. Cell now reads ≈$520–$940 (est.) for two with the method stated; the $3,000 figure was removed (F-52).
checks.source_label: Caesars Palace — Restaurant Guy Savoy main menu (official)

checks.detail: 5 courses $130, 7 courses $160, Signature $210 per person → $260 / $320 / $420 for two, before wine, tax and gratuity. Wine pairings $60 / $84 / $108 per person; foie gras add-on +$33 per guest.

checks.detail: Chef Tam's Signature Tasting Menu $198.88 per person → $397.76 for two. À la carte $18.88–$321.88 per dish; Imperial Peking Duck $148.88; wine journeys $128.88 / $208.88 per person.

checks.item: Social profiles — can any be verified from the venue itself?
checks.compared: Official venue sites read 2026-11-27 (SoulBelly BBQ, Kabuto, Partage, Esther's Kitchen, Lamaii, Yen Viet).
checks.detail: SoulBelly BBQ's own site links instagram.com/soulbellybbqlv, so that handle is now recorded. Kabuto links individual Instagram posts but not a profile; the others print no social links. No handle was guessed (Q-07, F-19).

irregularities.issue: Every row carries a 'verified' field, and 17 are set to 'yes'. Yet 21 of 24 rows have no couple price and 5 have no hours. The brief requires a couple price and hours for every restaurant, so the 'yes' label overstates how much is confirmed.
irregularities.action: Read 'verified' as 'the listing itself was confirmed', not 'every field is verified'. Blank fields remain blank and flagged.

irregularities.issue: No restaurant has an Instagram or TikTok link. The brief asks for a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram link for every entry where possible. The fields are blank by design (F-19), so the gap is open, not verified as nonexistent.
irregularities.action: Open item for the next session. Search official venue sites and their official social pages only.

irregularities.issue: 28 of 32 hotels were official_verified 'no', yet 29 rows carry verified 'yes'. Their prices come from Booking.com search results, not the property's own booking engine. The 'verified' label on those rows describes the search snapshot, not the room rate. Re-checked 2026-11-26: 18 of 32 official pages are now confirmed live by fetch, 8 refuse automated access, 5 were not opened and 1 lands on the parent property's page; 15 of the 32 price links are a dated search list rather than a room quote.
irregularities.action: Still treat every hotel price as an OTA snapshot until the property's own booking engine confirms it for the exact dates (Q-06). What changed on 2026-11-26: the link state is no longer ambiguous — each card says whether the official page was confirmed, refused automated access, was not opened, or lands on a sibling property's page, and search-list prices say so (F-48, F-49).

irregularities.issue: michelin_within_60 is 24 for all 32 hotels, so it cannot rank anything. The site already discloses this (Q-01); the ranking uses the 20-minute column instead. That column depends entirely on estimated travel times, which have no official source.
irregularities.action: Decide whether a 20-minute estimated metric is acceptable before the ranking is used for a decision (Q-01).

irregularities.issue: The data says the 2026 selection was announced 26 Aug 2026. The official press release page is dated 31 Aug 2026. The ceremony date is not stated on the official page, and the 26 Aug date could not be traced to an official source.
irregularities.action: Correct the date only after confirming the ceremony date from an official source. Not changed in this session.

irregularities.issue: The archived subsite says é by José Andrés is open Tue–Sun. The official Cosmopolitan page says Tuesday to Saturday, closed Sunday. The canonical data is correct. The archive is left as it was; this is a record of the conflict.
irregularities.action: Do not use the archived é hours. The canonical data (Tue–Sat) matches the official page.

irregularities.issue: Three different flag counts appear. FLAGS.md has 28 entries (F-01 to F-28). The README says 22. The Sources page is hard-coded to 20.
irregularities.action: Corrected: the README now says 28, and the Sources page derives the count from FLAGS.md.

irregularities.issue: The hotel official_url links were not re-fetched this session. Earlier notes say 28 of 32 were not fetched (F-27).
irregularities.action: Open. Each link should be fetched and recorded before the site is relied on for a booking.

irregularities.issue: Michael Mina at Bellagio is marked Temporarily closed and lists no hours, yet its $590++ price is still shown on the row (F-23).
irregularities.action: Do not offer this table as bookable. The price must be read as a historical menu price, not a 2027 price.

irregularities.issue: The suggestions page says 17 of 24 restaurants have fully verified hours and days. The data has 5 blank-hour rows, so the count is 19 with hours, not 17. The 17 matches the number of rows marked verified.
irregularities.action: Corrected in data/suggestions.json, so the sentence now states 19 with hours, 5 blank, and 17 marked verified.

irregularities.issue: Task ID T10 is used twice, for two different tasks. The board also records T1–T9 as claimed by several sessions, and the brief asked for session-<id>/<task> branch names. This platform allows only the session branch, so the names were not used.
irregularities.action: Tasks in this session are numbered T12 and claimed on the board. Duplicate T10 entries are left as history.
